baseline_models.focus_anchor: The feminine dual possessive construction attaches the plural afnan to two bearers, while ف ن ن B003 supplies branching twigs and extended locks.
baseline_models.mechanism: Each bearer is defined by repeated outward division: limbs leave a stem, extend, and multiply the available canopy edge.

activation_trace.role: A branching twig or extended lock supplies visible ramification and makes the two bearers canopy-forming.

changed_reading.before: The two gardens merely possess vegetation.
changed_reading.after: The two are specifically bough-bearing canopies whose identity lies in ramified extension.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Afnan remains anchored in ف ن ن, whose B002 inventory includes types, modes, ways, and shifts of style.
baseline_models.mechanism: Possession is qualitative rather than only botanical: each of the two holds a repertoire that can branch from one mode into another.

activation_trace.role: Types, modes, and ways turn plural afnan into an internal repertoire rather than a count of limbs.

changed_reading.after: Afnan can also denote manifold kinds, paths, or styles possessed by each member of the pair.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same focus root carries B004, a mixed, nonuniform, and unstable variegation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two bearers may be compositionally mottled: their abundance consists in heterogeneous patches and transitions rather than uniform repetition.

activation_trace.role: Mixed, unstable variegation supplies a patchwork mechanism and prevents assuming visual uniformity.

changed_reading.before: The two gardens display homogeneous luxuriance.
changed_reading.after: They may possess shifting, nonuniform pattern and mixed coloration as part of their afnan.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus-root B005 names a standing condition and B006 a stretch or portion of time.
baseline_models.mechanism: Plural possession can be durational: the pair bears multiple conditions or phases, so its abundance unfolds instead of remaining a frozen scene.

activation_trace.role: A standing condition makes each afnan a possible state carried by the pair.
A portion of time turns plurality into successive phases rather than simultaneous objects.

changed_reading.before: The phrase describes a stable spatial property.
changed_reading.after: The two may possess successive states or stretches in which their abundance keeps changing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus-root B007 permits fann as a wondrous or strange matter.
baseline_models.mechanism: The plural can inventory marvels: each bearer produces not only vegetation but successive occasions of astonishment.

activation_trace.role: A wondrous matter makes afnan a plurality of marvel-events carried by the two bearers.

changed_reading.before: The line offers a compact botanical descriptor.
changed_reading.after: It can also announce two possessors of manifold wonders.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dense growth hides the garden, springs feed moving channels, and the ramified network terminates in harvest brought downward within reach.

activation_trace.role: Branching twigs provide the physical network whose circulation and yield the context activates.
Intertwined, thrusting vegetation makes the named gardens active growth masses rather than empty enclosures.
Flow and spreading supply motion, turning ramification into conducting channels.
A source of running water supplies the feeder points for the branch-like channels.
Taking harvest from its growth-site makes the ramified system productive.
The upper part descending toward the middle makes reachability an effect of branch geometry.

structural_cues: 55:46 names the two gardens, while 55:50-54 moves from running springs through paired fruit to near harvest.
The feminine dual in 55:48 resumes the dual gardens and keeps the whole mechanism attached to them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies intertwined growth, water sources, flow, harvest, and descending upper growth; the reader supplies the arrows water-feeds-boughs and boughs-lower-harvest; a live alternative is an unconnected list of amenities.

changed_reading.before: The two gardens simply have many boughs.
changed_reading.after: They are self-concealing, ramified systems that conduct water into reachable yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: The modal sense of afnan becomes an exhaustive pairing operation: each garden branches internally into kinds whose members are joined as counterparts.

activation_trace.role: Types, modes, and ways supply the focus category that the later pair-construction organizes.
Pleasant fruit gives the modal plurality a concrete domain of realization.
Encircling completeness extends the mechanism over every fruit-kind rather than a sample.
A color or kind of a thing makes each pair an explicit branching of category.

structural_cues: Dual morphology recurs in 55:46, 55:48, 55:50, 55:52, and again in 55:62-66.
55:52 places totality, fruit, and pairing in one compact construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies total fruit and paired kinds; the reader supplies the arrow that pairing instantiates afnan as a taxonomy inside each garden; a live alternative is that afnan stays literal while pairing is merely another benefit.

changed_reading.before: Afnan means either physical branches or unsorted variety.
changed_reading.after: Each garden is a branching repertoire whose varieties arrive as joined counterparts.

context_deltas.mechanism: Branching becomes a topology of relation: limbs or modes converge and interlace, but measured junctions preserve the interval between them and prevent one side from overrunning the other.

activation_trace.role: A branching twig supplies diverging and potentially reconverging limbs.
A connection standing between endpoints makes separation itself a linking structure.
Balancing and aligning two things regulates how the two branching systems face each other.
An intertwined bough supplies the exact image of contact without simple fusion.
Two opposed things arriving together supplies the junction event.
Crossing a limit by aggression defines the failure that the bounded branch-junction avoids.

structural_cues: 55:19-20 pairs two meeting seas with an intervening barrier and non-transgression.
55:7-9 establishes alignment and just measure before the dual-boundary scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies paired meeting, an interval-link, alignment, interlacing, and prohibited overrun; the reader supplies the arrow that these relations redescribe garden boughs as bounded junctions; a live alternative is a water-only analogy unrelated to 55:48.

changed_reading.before: Branching primarily means more vegetal mass.
changed_reading.after: The two gardens possess a relational architecture of limbs that meet, balance, and remain distinct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The unstable patchwork latent in ف ن ن is recoded as designed heterogeneity: mixture and contrasting colors remain lively, while proportion prevents them from becoming incoherent.

activation_trace.role: Mixed, nonuniform variegation supplies the risky patchwork that context constrains.
A created thing proportioned in balance turns random-looking variation into composed difference.
Mixture and perturbation supply the heterogeneous motion within the design.
Two colors occurring in one thing provide a visible realization of controlled variegation.
Deep dark coloration supplies a saturated tonal pole in the later garden pair.
Green shading, including green intensified toward darkness, joins color difference to vegetation.

structural_cues: 55:7-9 repeatedly establishes measure before the surah turns to mixed natural materials.
The later garden sequence alternates deep-dark vegetation, fruit, green spread, and patterned furnishings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies proportion, mixture, dual coloration, and dark-green tonal poles; the reader supplies the arrow that measure rehabilitates the focus branch's defect-like patchwork as intentional composition; a live alternative keeps B004 pejorative and subordinate to literal boughs.

changed_reading.before: The B004 possibility suggests muddled or defective inconsistency.
changed_reading.after: The two gardens can carry measured heterogeneity: mixed textures and colors held in a coherent proportion.

context_deltas.mechanism: A context root unexpectedly couples cessation with a branch-bearing tree; the following sequence of remaining, bounded duration, and recurrent condition activates afnan as phases through which growth is repeatedly lost and renewed.

activation_trace.role: A standing condition lets the gardens possess more than one active state.
A stretch of time gives those states duration and sequence.
Cessation after continuance supplies the terminal edge of a phase.
A branch-bearing tree creates an unusual lexical bridge from passing away back to the focus boughs.
Continuance supplies the counter-pole through which one phase outlasts another.
A duration of time makes recurrence explicit rather than merely spatial.
An affair or condition supplies the changing content carried by each duration.

structural_cues: 55:26-29 orders passing away, remaining, and an every-day condition before the garden promise.
The sharp lexical collision inside the ف ن ي inventory links termination and branch-bearing without requiring either to erase the other.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies cessation, continuance, temporal duration, changing condition, and a tree-with-afnan bridge; the reader supplies cyclical renewal as the connecting arrow; a live alternative is a linear eschatological sequence with no seasonal mechanism in 55:48.

changed_reading.before: The focus temporal senses are isolated dictionary possibilities.
changed_reading.after: The two gardens become duration-bearing regimes whose conditions renew across moments of ending and continuance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated naming of favors serializes each garden feature as a disclosed marvel, while the later rare and astonishing furnishing confirms wonder as an organizing quality rather than incidental emotion.

activation_trace.role: A wondrous matter makes plural afnan a series of marvels.
Favors supply the repeated evaluative frame that presents each marvel as a gift.
Rare elevation and astonishing force give the catalogue a culminating wonder-quality.

structural_cues: The refrain occurs immediately before and after 55:48 and after each subsequent garden detail.
55:76 ends the catalogue with a rare, astonishing furnishing cue before the final refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies repeated favors and a culminating astonishing quality; the reader supplies the arrow that the refrain parcels the gardens into successive afnan of wonder; a live alternative treats B007 as an unrelated root sense.

changed_reading.before: Wonder is only an optional affect attached to botanical abundance.
changed_reading.after: The two are possessors of serial marvels, with each disclosed feature functioning as one wondrous mode.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden catalogue can function as enacted clarification: modes branch like styles of discourse, each subsequent detail making a different aspect of the paired gift legible.

activation_trace.role: Modes and shifts of style provide the speech-domain bridge inside the focus root.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic result of the branching presentation.
Recitation and reading supply the voiced sequence in which the modes unfold.
Revealing meaning through speech or sign turns each garden detail into an articulating branch.

structural_cues: 55:1-4 opens with teaching, recitation, creation, and clarification in a tight chain.
The repeated second-person interrogative refrain makes the garden catalogue part of an addressed discourse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies disclosure, recitation, explanation, and a focus branch that includes stylistic modes; the reader supplies the arrow that the garden sequence performs bayan by changing descriptive mode; a live alternative confines all three opening cues to revelation and leaves 55:48 botanical.

changed_reading.before: Afnan are varieties located inside the gardens.
changed_reading.after: The paired gardens also operate as an articulated display whose successive features are branching modes of clarification.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from arboriculture into hair and textiles; it remains anchored in the explicit lock-image of focus B003 and is reinforced by hair, lining, hanging edge, and patterned furnishing branches. Render only as a personifying material overlay in which vegetation looks tressed or clothed, never as a claim that the two grammatical gardens are women.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The B003 focus branch explicitly joins a branching twig to an extended lock, allowing canopy and tress to coexist.

activation_trace.role: The twig-lock image anchors vegetal ramification and flowing tress in the same focus word.
Combed or lengthened hair supplies an explicit hair-domain counterpart to the focus lock.
A garment lining adds layered interior textile structure to the canopy-personification.
A hanging or fluttering edge gives the imagined tresses and canopy a fringed contour.
Fine patterned carpets extend branch-variegation into crafted surface ornament.

changed_reading.before: The two gardens have woody limbs above furnishings.
changed_reading.after: The gardens can be imagined as tressed and clothed bodies whose green hanging edges, inner linings, and patterns continue the logic of branching.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because ordinary afnan strongly favors boughs, yet focus B001 genuinely supplies hard driving and pressure while the immediate pre-garden sequence supplies blocked passage, overpowering force, and fear. Carry it only as a speculative mechanical reversal: coercive vectors become protected forks or routes inside the reward-space, never as a replacement for the canopy reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The reading attaches solely through ف ن ن B001, the focus root's hard-driving branch, refracted through the plural possessive construction.

activation_trace.role: Hard pressing and driving supply directional force to otherwise static branches.
An unobstructed through-passage supplies the route-form whose failure precedes the gardens.
Overpowering force supplies the pressure regime from which the garden vectors are read as reversal.
Fear anticipating harm locates the transition from coercive pressure to protected ramification.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are forked force-lines or routes whose outward drive reverses the preceding scene of blocked penetration and threat.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it converts punitive and cosmic fire imagery into botany through cross-branch echoes. It remains anchored in focus B003 and in packet branches that place flame, tree-bloom, red flower-color, and intertwined boughs along the same sequence. Render as a speculative visual-material transformation from forking flame to flowering branch, not as lexical identity between fire and garden.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus B003 supplies the receiving image of a ramified bough onto which prior flame and bloom cues can be mapped.

activation_trace.role: A branching twig supplies the cool botanical endpoint of the transformation.
A darting flame supplies a forking energetic precursor to the bough.
An intertwined branch inside the same root inventory provides the internal flame-to-bough hinge.
Tree blossom within the fire-root inventory converts heat imagery into flowering growth.
Flower and red-infused color mediate the visible shift from burning sky to bloom.

changed_reading.before: The boughs begin a separate reward tableau after the fire sequence.
changed_reading.after: The boughs can also complete a transformation in which forking flame and rose-red rupture cool into intertwined, flower-bearing growth.

strongest_changes: Static boughs became a hydraulic, harvest-bearing ramification system.
Unsorted abundance became an exhaustive architecture of paired kinds.
Branching became bounded interlacing: connection without collapse or transgression.
Defect-like variegation became measured heterogeneity rather than being discarded.
Remote time, wonder, and speech-mode branches became live coexisting readings through explicit context collisions.
summary.what_was_special: The focus has only one rooted word, but its inventory crosses botany, modality, unstable pattern, condition, duration, wonder, and force. Context did not select one winner; it turned those senses into several inspectable mechanisms, especially through the unexpected ف ن ي tree-with-afnan bridge and the flame-to-bloom and tress-textile outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: The temporal reading has a strong context bridge but remains morphologically distant from the ordinary plural noun.
Measured variegation depends on rehabilitating a branch whose inventory remains defect-like and unstable.
The rhetorical, tressed, driven-route, and fireflower readings should remain qualified overlays rather than displace the strong botanical model.
Paired kinds and literal boughs may operate simultaneously; the packet does not require disambiguation between them.
